verdict.rationale: Datadog's Agent Observability SDK provides `LLMObs.submit_evaluation()` and an evaluations API. Engineers can compute their own code-based evaluation results and attach them to spans, traces, or sessions as first-party custom evaluations. Its experiments feature supports datasets and comparisons, but no evidence shows code-based scorer functions plugged into experiments. The documented custom evaluators are LLM-as-a-judge, not code. Missing for 10: documented custom code scorer/evaluator functions within experiments, details on custom metric types and aggregation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations

citations.quote: The Agent Observability SDK provides the methods `LLMObs.submit_evaluation()` and `LLMObs.export_span()` to help your traced LLM application submit external evaluations to Agent Observability.
You can use the evaluations API provided by Agent Observability to send evaluations associated with spans, traces, or sessions to Datadog.
